note: Analyst reading of the news, written by the weekly agent from logged events. Not data. Replace every week.
headline: The US struck Iran again: on Nov 17 US jets hit an IRGC missile launch site on Qeshm Island, which officials call 'self-defense' after IRGC drones were aimed at a US radar in Bahrain the same day (#179, #180). No casualties were reported.

Iranian drones then went at Ali Al Salem air base in Kuwait, apparently Iran's first attack there in two months, and at Bahrain on Nov 18; all were intercepted and no US personnel were hurt (#181, #183).

Shipping: the LPG tanker Tara Gas was hit twice near Khasab (Nov 16-17; one crew member missing, two badly burned, #178) and an ADNOC L&S tanker was hit (one missing, 11 injured, #182). CENTCOM now says ship-to-ship transfers of Iranian cargo can count as running the blockade (#184).

No deal and no direct talks. Trump threatened Iran over reported chemical and 'dirty bomb' plans (#188), says Iran's terms are unacceptable and he is 'not rushing' (#189), and the Shenzhen summit with Xi and Putin left Iran out of its declaration (#187).
The USS George Washington left the region; two US carriers remain (#185). Treasury sanctioned a Hizballah / IRGC-Qods Force finance network (#186).
